summary: The debug module prints messages or variable values during a run without stopping the playbook, useful alongside when and on Windows targets.
questions: How do I print a variable's value while a playbook runs?
Can I use debug on Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: Print values with debug
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.debug` prints messages or variables during execution without halting the play. Combine with `when:` for conditional output. Works on Windows too.
